##: PersistentWindows is packaged for x64 Windows only. This marker prevents Scoop from falling back to the x64 build on ARM64.
description: Utility that persists and restores window positions and sizes when displays change
notes: Start PersistentWindows from the Start menu. It runs in the notification area without a main window.
Run it as administrator only if windows of elevated programs should also be restored.
Data is stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\PersistentWindows and is not managed by Scoop.
Update with 'scoop update persistentwindows'. The shortcut disables the in-app upgrade check.
Automatic startup at login is opt-in. Create your own startup shortcut or scheduled task if wanted.
Upstream suggests overriding high DPI scaling for PersistentWindows if fractional display scaling causes issues.
